title: SonarQube + OpenAI: Agentic Development — Killian Carlsen-Phelan, Sonar
talk_summary: A Sonar engineer demos wiring static analysis (SonarQube) into the Codex agent loop via hooks, MCP, and skills so that secrets are blocked before model context, issues are pulled into the terminal, and every agent edit is re-scanned server-side for newly introduced defects. The framing is that the bottleneck has shifted from code generation to verification, and that 'done' must mean done-with-evidence, with containment (sandboxing) not equal to correctness.

takeaways.technique: Post-edit incremental static analysis hook (agentic analysis)
takeaways.what_they_do: A post-tool-use hook fires immediately after any agent file edit and runs server-side analysis on just the changed code, reporting only newly introduced issues (pre-existing ones are ignored) so the agent iterates until clean.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the post tool use hook for agentic analysis will run... if there were any new vulnerabilities introduced in the fix sonar cube will scan it server side

takeaways.what_they_do: A hook on prompt-submit and file-read blocks secrets from ever entering the model's context or logs; the agent is refused rather than trusted to redact.
takeaways.evidence_quote: instantly this was blocked. No secrets were leaked into the L1 context. Nothing is being stored in any logs
takeaways.numbers: average remediation time for a secret in a public repo is 90 days

takeaways.what_they_do: Before a task, a skill fetches project guidelines, rules, and architecture and injects them so the agent has high-quality context before generating; speaker claims this reduces token cost.

takeaways.technique: Issue-list + find-and-fix via MCP into the agent terminal
takeaways.what_they_do: An MCP server exposes Sonar issues as tools so the agent can list issues and fix a specific rule ID in-loop, closing guide/verify/solve without leaving the terminal.
Require a reviewable diff plus tool evidence (compiler, tests, analysis) before a task counts as complete; self-critique is explicitly not treated as an independent oracle.
takeaways.evidence_quote: It doesn't mean just saying fixed. It actually means saying fixed and providing the evidence supporting this fact.

takeaways.technique: Shift verification left into the inner loop
takeaways.what_they_do: Run verification inside the agent/IDE loop right after generation instead of waiting for the outer CI pipeline, to avoid push-fail-fix cycles.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we want to save time by shifting left to the interloop... without having to push it out
